verdict.rationale: The x402 protocol has been contributed to the Linux Foundation's x402 Foundation under 'open, vendor-neutral governance'. Its SDK is published publicly on npm by the Foundation with SLSA provenance, so the protocol code can be obtained and read. However, no evidence names an open-source license or a public source repository, and the hosted CDP Facilitator is a closed, auth-gated service. missing for 10: an explicitly named open-source license, a link to the public source repository, any statement on facilitator source availability, and independent confirmation of licensing.
